hooks.command: file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); [[ "$file" == *.tf ]] && terraform fmt "$(dirname "$file")" 2>/dev/null; exit 0

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$file" == *.tfstate* ]] || [[ "$file" == */.terraform/* ]]; then echo 'ERROR: Direct edits to .tfstate files and .terraform/ directories are blocked. Use terraform commands instead.' >&2; exit 1; fi
